problems.title: Missing Number
problems.notes: XOR or the sum-formula both beat cyclic sort here — know all three, the interviewer will probe which is 'better' and why

problems.title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array
problems.notes: in-place cyclic sort, or sign-marking at index |nums[i]|-1, gets you O(n) time and O(1) extra space

problems.title: Set Mismatch
problems.notes: cyclic sort finds the swapped pair (the duplicate and the missing number) in a single pass

problems.title: Find All Duplicates in an Array
problems.notes: sign-marking variant of cyclic sort: values are 1..n, so index into the array itself as a visited set

problems.title: Max Chunks To Make Sorted
problems.notes: not cyclic sort itself, but the same 'permutation of 0..n-1 in place' reasoning: a chunk closes when runningMax == index

problems.title: First Missing Positive
problems.notes: THE cyclic sort problem: place nums[i] at index nums[i]-1 in place, then scan for the first index that's still wrong, O(n)/O(1)
